## Services Overview

M2 Cybersec provides comprehensive cybersecurity solutions tailored to different business sizes and needs:

### Security Packages

1. **Starter-Paket** (For Startups & Founders)
   - Quick external security check
   - Basic analysis (1-2 hours)
   - Single target testing
   - Clear action recommendations
   - Optional consultation call
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/starter-paket/

2. **Growth-Paket** (For Growing Teams)
   - Multi-target security check (2-3 systems)
   - Detailed analysis and reporting
   - 3 comprehensive security checks per year
   - Password and MFA baseline policies
   - Structured PDF reports
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/growth-paket/

3. **Scale-Paket** (For Professional Teams)
   - Comprehensive security check (5+ systems)
   - External and internal testing
   - Source code review
   - Detailed CVSS reports with action plans
   - 3 awareness training sessions per year
   - Custom incident response plan
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/scale-paket/

4. **Enterprise-Paket** (For Enterprise Organizations)
   - Complete infrastructure and cloud assessment
   - Red-teaming simulations
   - Extended CVSS reports with risk dashboard
   - Awareness and incident response training
   - CISO-as-a-Service consulting
   - 24/7 monitoring and incident response
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/enterprise-paket/

### Additional Services

1. **IT Security for SMEs**
   - Risk analysis and vulnerability detection
   - Security concepts and consulting
   - Web application penetration testing
   - Information security management (ISM)
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/sicherheit-fuer-kmu/

2. **Awareness+ Training**
   - Phishing prevention training
   - Ransomware protection education
   - Cyber risk management strategies
   - Interactive employee training sessions
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/awareness-training-fuer-kmu/

3. **Red Team Plus**
   - 360° security audit
   - Technical penetration testing
   - Employee awareness checks
   - Physical security assessments
   - Realistic threat scenario simulations
   - URL: https://m2cybersec.de.de/red-team-plus/

## Core Competencies

- Penetration Testing & Ethical Hacking
- Security Consulting & Strategy
- Risk Assessment & Compliance (DSGVO, ISO 27001, NIS2)
- Incident Response & Forensics
- Security Awareness Training
- CISO-as-a-Service
- 24/7 Security Monitoring

## Target Audience

- Startups and early-stage companies
- Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs)
- Growing tech teams
- Enterprise organizations
- Companies requiring compliance (ISO 27001, KRITIS, NIS2)
- Organizations with existing IT service providers seeking independent audits

## Key Differentiators

- Tailored solutions for different company sizes
- Practical, actionable recommendations
- Holistic approach (technical, organizational, human factors)
- Transparent communication and reports
- 24/7 availability for security incidents
- Independent external security assessments
